lead.description: the replacement of a long list of measurements by a short list of coordinates that keeps most of their variation or their shape

overview_sentence: [Dimensionality reduction](articles/dimensionality-reduction.qmd) replaces many measurements by a few coordinates that keep most of the variation.

self_checks.title: Sum of squares
self_checks.prompt: The centred points are (-1,-1), (0,0) and (1,1). What is the total sum of squares?
self_checks.answer: The total sum of squares is 4.

self_checks.title: Horizontal fraction
self_checks.prompt: If only the horizontal coordinate of those centred points is kept, what fraction of the sum of squares is retained?

self_checks.title: Discarded sum of squares
self_checks.prompt: What sum of squares is discarded by keeping only the horizontal coordinate?
self_checks.answer: The discarded sum of squares is 2.
